name: Luchadora
review:
Mexican wrestling on 30 lines, with wrestler wilds, an Underdog feature, Lucha Smackdown and free spins.

The Underdog and Lucha Smackdown features shake up ordinary spins, and wrestler wilds help line up wins across the paylines. Medium volatility keeps the balance moving steadily rather than swinging wildly. 1,995x cap, 96.2% RTP. Lively and good-humoured, and an easy one to pick up.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
